name: The Lost Verse
canDoWhy: Runs quietly from Bard's Leap Summit; it only shows in your journal once you have the ancient Edda fragment to show someone.

starts.where: Bard's Leap Summit, in the Reach
starts.how: The quest is tied to Azzadal and a starting object at Bard's Leap Summit; the journal task appears once you hold the ancient Edda fragment.

firstStep: Show the ancient Edda fragment to someone

takesYou.why: where Azzadal is and where the Edda fragment comes from
show the fragment to Giraud Gemane

objectives: Show the ancient Edda fragment to someone

rewards.what: An item from the quest's reward list
rewards.when: when you hand the fragment over to Giraud Gemane

people.name: Azzadal
people.role: the ghost bard at Bard's Leap Summit

people.name: Giraud Gemane
people.role: teacher at the Bards College in Solitude; the one to show the fragment to

unsure.why: The quest has a 'starter object' and an 'Edda part' but the early stages have no journal text, so these files don't show what exactly you touch or do at the summit to set it going.
Giraud is placed in the Bards College; his schedule also has him teaching class there and eating lunch at the Winking Skeever, so he may not be in the College at midday.
The reward is a leveled list; its contents aren't in these files. That it is given when you talk to Giraud is read from the turn-in dialogue being his.
dvEdda.esp, which also reworks Collecting the Edda, is the last edit; these files don't show what it changed here.

evidence: Azzadal Skyrim.esm:0B3C81 ref 0B3C82 at Bard's Leap Summit, essential

name: Clear Dead Men's Respite
plugin: BardExcavation.esp (Bards College Excavation; no later edits)
canDoWhy: Two bards camped at the door of Dead Men's Respite ask you to clear the tomb.

starts.where: camped outside the entrance to Dead Men's Respite, a short walk from Morthal
starts.how: Talk to Rothen (or Birinna, who camps with him) and he asks you to clear the tomb.

starts.where: camped outside the entrance to Dead Men's Respite, a short walk from Morthal
starts.how: She can give the same task as Rothen.

takesYou.why: clear the tomb, then tell the bards

objectives: Inform the bards that the tomb is clear.

people.name: Rothen Adlvel
people.role: Dunmer bard of the Bards College, camped outside Dead Men's Respite

unsure.why: No reward is listed in these files.

Dead Men's Respite is also where Tending the Flames sends you; these files don't show whether doing one affects the other. The tomb is dangerous: creatures from level 6 up to a level 85 boss, King Olaf One-Eye, plus traps.

The bards camp outside the tomb and sometimes go inside; once their own story moves on they spend weekends at the Bards College in Solitude, and after Laid to Rest is done they take dinner at the Moorside Inn in Morthal. These files don't say when the College move happens.

evidence: giver Rothen INFO BardExcavation.esp:000863 (stage < 6), also Birinna
Rothen ref 000803 / Birinna ref 000804 in exterior cell Skyrim.esm:009407 (door 062ED6 into Dead Men's Respite)
packages DMRespiteExteriorSandbox/Sleep, DMBardsCollegeStaySaturday/Sunday (BardExcavation.esp:000843 stage 5), DMBardsMoorsideDinner (MS14 stage 200 done)
